events.name: Cyclone Arnab
events.summary: One saved event: eye pass 27 Oct (Track 48), delta before/after pair on Track 55 (16 Oct, 28 Oct, 9 Nov) against a normal period of 4-16 Oct.

analyses.caveat: 9 Nov combines Cyclone Arnab (27-28 Oct), Cyclone Murasu (1-3 Nov) and the Godavari peak (about 2 Nov). Radar-only classes, not validated against a flood map. Wet-or-flooded crops is not storm-specific.
